name: gomailtesttool
free_limit: MIT-licensed local command-line toolkit for testing SMTP, IMAP, POP3, JMAP, Exchange EWS, Microsoft Graph and Gmail connectivity, authentication, mail operations and TLS; no software subscription, usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Runs on the user's Windows, Linux or macOS machine; not a hosted email service, inbox or free email sending allowance. Real mail accounts, Microsoft 365/Google Workspace access, credentials, network connectivity and provider API limits or fees remain separate. Some commands can send, export or delete real messages.
